description: The PABLO project developed collaborative forest planning around the Occhito reservoir. Its community of practice connects forest management, nature-based measures and protection of the surrounding landscape under changing climate conditions. The resource is documented by European Environment Agency, Climate-ADAPT (case-study publisher). The application is located in Occhito Lake, Puglia. This is a narrative case, not a regularly gridded or periodically sampled dataset; intervention dates and later updates are given in the source. The case narrative is freely readable as a web page. A licence for reusing the underlying project data is not established. Reported interventions and projected benefits must be distinguished; the case does not supply a ready-to-run simulation. It can inform green-blue infrastructure adaptation scenarios, intervention assumptions and institutional constraints. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
